title: Level 1: Everyday Basics
description: Master foundational introductions and fingerspelling greetings.

lessons.title: The Name Game
lessons.subtitle: Spell out your introduction with fingerspelling signs
lessons.description: Arrange the scrambled letters to spell the word asked in the avatar's gesture.
lessons.prompt: Spell the word 'NAME' by dragging the letters into the target slots:
lessons.hint: The avatar gestures 'Your name what?'. Assemble N-A-M-E.

lessons.title: Meet & Greet
lessons.subtitle: Recognize friendly welcome signs
lessons.description: Observe the 3D avatar's hand gesture and choose the correct English greeting.
lessons.prompt: Which greeting is the avatar signing in this gesture?
lessons.hint: Notice the open hand starting near the forehead and moving outwards.
lessons.explanation: A gentle wave or hand to temple moving outwards is 'Hello'.

title: Level 2: The Grocery Run
description: Navigate the marketplace and order fresh fruits & daily essentials.

lessons.title: The Grocery Run
lessons.subtitle: Visual grocery selection
lessons.description: Watch the food sign carefully and select the corresponding grocery card.
lessons.prompt: Which grocery item is being requested by the 3D avatar?
lessons.hint: Observe the knuckle rotation against the cheek.
lessons.explanation: In Indian & British sign language, twisting the knuckle at the cheek represents 'Apple'.

lessons.title: Marketplace Gratitude
lessons.subtitle: Courteous checkout gesture
lessons.description: Identify what polite phrase the customer gestures after the clerk hands over the grocery bag.
lessons.prompt: What courteous phrase is the avatar signing at checkout?
lessons.hint: Flat fingers touching the chin or lips moving gently forward.
lessons.explanation: Extending flat fingers from the lips forward is the universal sign for 'Thank You'.

title: Level 3: Community & Family
description: Master relational bonds and two-handed conversational dialogue.

lessons.title: Lifelong Companions
lessons.subtitle: Relational signs and companionship
lessons.description: Observe how the two hands interact to represent social connections.
lessons.prompt: Which social relationship is represented by these interlocking gestures?
lessons.hint: Two index fingers hooking together signifies a strong bond.
lessons.explanation: Interlocking or hooking index fingers together denotes 'Friend'.
